portable_review.help.message: Connect to the target Zabbix, choose visible hosts for the role and review matches. Other hosts may match the mask. Confirmation is temporary and does not authorize publication.

portable_review.truncated.message: The host list is incomplete; refine your search.

portable_review.acknowledge_outside.message: I reviewed the visible matches outside the selected hosts.

portable_review.confirmed.message: Matches confirmed for this review. They must be checked again before publication.

portable_review.failed.message: Review failed or changed. Check the connection and repeat the preview.

portable_lld.help.message: Choose a target host for each slot. For a catalog metric, confirm a matching item on that host.

portable_lld.confirmed.message: Selection saved locally and checked. It must be checked again before publication.

portable_lld.failed.message: Unable to verify the binding. Check the draft, connection and access to the source.
